name: WarpDeck
summary:
WarpDeck gets you into VR faster.

Put the headset on after a reboot and WarpDeck is already there. A clean countdown ticks down to your favorite game or app. Do nothing and you launch straight in. Changed your mind? Tap Cancel and pick something else from your Quick Launch panel. No library scrolling. No menu hunting. Boot. Countdown. You are in.
